headline: Sensex falls 429 points as RBI hikes interest rates; Nifty ends at 22,603 amid inflation concerns

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: The RBI hiked interest rates for the first time in nearly four years to combat persistent price pressure.
US 30-year bond yields hit a fresh 24-year high, dampening global investor sentiment.
The Indian Rupee neared a record low despite the central bank's rate hike action.
Rising UK Gilt and US Treasury yields weighed heavily on global bond and equity markets.
whatHappening: The BSE Sensex dropped 429 points to close at 22,603, while the Nifty 50 struggled to hold the 22,600 level.
Bharti Airtel shares rose over 2% following the launch of new service plans, defying the broader market selloff.
Granules India is seeking 180-day exclusivity for a generic version of the cancer drug Ruxolitinib in the U.S.
RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra noted that markets can be irrational in the short run as the Rupee faced pressure.
summary: Indian markets closed lower as the RBI hiked interest rates to tackle inflation, sending the Sensex down 429 points. While most sectors faced pressure, Bharti Airtel and Kotak Mahindra Bank showed resilience with gains. Global cues, including surging US bond yields and a weakening Rupee, further dampened investor sentiment.
